title: Ultra-weak protein-protein interactions can modulate proteome-wide searching and binding
authors: Jennifer L. Hofmann; Akshay J. Maheshwari; Alp M. Sunol; Drew Endy; Roseanna N. Zia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究超弱蛋白-蛋白相互作用对蛋白搜索和结合的影响，虽涉及动态模拟但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Research on protein-protein interaction (PPIs) tends to focus on high affinity interactions. Weaker interactions ( K d >1 μM ) recently understood as contributing to intracellular phase separation suggest that even-weaker PPIs might also matter in as-yet unknown ways. However, ultra-weak PPIs ( K d >1 mM ) are not readily accessible by in vivo techniques. Here we use protein electrostatics to estimate PPI strengths and spatially-resolved dynamic simulations to investigate the potential impacts of ultra-weak PPIs within dense protein suspensions. We find that ultra-weak PPIs can drive formation of transient clusters that last long enough to enable enzyme-catalyzed reactions and accelerate the sampling of protein associations. We apply our method to Mycoplasma genitalium , finding that ultra-weak PPIs should be ubiquitous among cytoplasmic proteins. We also predict that the proteome-wide interactome can be shifted to favor ‘binding-dominant’ ultra-weak PPIs via the introduction of a few charged protein complexes. We speculate that ultra-weak PPIs could contribute to cellular fitness by facilitating sampling and colloidal-scale transport of proteins involved in biological processes, including protein synthesis.
abstract_zh: 关于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的研究往往聚焦于高亲和力的相互作用。较弱的相互作用（K d >1 μM）近期被认为有助于细胞内相分离（phase separation），这提示甚至更弱的PPIs可能也以尚未知晓的方式发挥作用。然而，超弱PPIs（K d >1 mM）不易通过体内技术获取。在此，我们利用蛋白质静电学来估算PPI强度，并采用空间分辨动态模拟来研究超弱PPIs在密集蛋白质悬浮液中的潜在影响。我们发现，超弱PPIs能够驱动形成短暂聚集体，这些聚集体持续时间足以支持酶催化反应，并加速蛋白质关联的采样过程。我们将此方法应用于生殖支原体（Mycoplasma genitalium），发现超弱PPIs在细胞质蛋白质中应普遍存在。我们还预测，通过引入少量带电蛋白质复合物，全蛋白质组相互作用组可被调整以偏向“结合主导型”超弱PPIs。我们推测，超弱PPIs可能通过促进参与生物过程（包括蛋白质合成）的蛋白质的采样和胶体尺度运输，从而有助于细胞适应性。
